gaps.required_work: Implement bounded worker adapters that actually invoke registered local/remote executors, enforce timeouts/cancellation/authority, stream lifecycle events, bind exact input/output evidence, and feed success/failure into retry/reassignment semantics.
Persist workers, tasks, assignments, retry/dead-letter state, telemetry chain, and snapshots transactionally across restart; prove crash/restart recovery and concurrent writers.

Replace the uptime-only sidecar with a real machine service exposing worker registration/heartbeat, task submission/status/cancel, telemetry, swarm status, and crystallization dispatch with authentication/authority boundaries.
Tie health/readiness to durable store availability, scheduler integrity, worker execution adapters, and queue liveness; add graceful start/drain/shutdown and dependency failure behavior.

Prove semantic reconstruction against real heterogeneous repositories and lineage evidence; add structured evidence retrieval/normalization and refusal when purpose or material capability inference remains ambiguous.

Execute real repository work through the Swarm task engine rather than a standalone ThreadPool; bind repository dependency ordering, worker results, branch/PR evidence, retries, and resumable state into one orchestration path.

Persist the canonical estate ledger durably, reconcile repeated runs and repository renames/deletions/successors, record deployment endpoints/artifacts, and prove that unresolved counts cannot be lost between runs.

Build repository lineage/dependency/shared-capability graph generation and use it to drive execution order, successor resolution, reusable component extraction, and cross-estate integration decisions.

Package and deploy the agent-service runtime with explicit environment/secrets contract, authenticated network boundary, health/readiness, structured logs, reproducible release, smoke test, and operational rollback; record a real deployment receipt.
